title: Trade Relationship Manager
description:
ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
 * Responsible for advancing the sales process, closing new business, and achieving/assisting in sales targets.
* Actively participate in the planning and execution of the company’s marketing activities, providing vital inputs based on interactions with prospects.
* Support and service existing customers by addressing their queries and resolving issues.


 DETAILED DESCRIPTION
 * Work on sales leads received through platform transactions, on\-ground sales personnel, and digital marketing sources.
* Establish connections with potential clients, explain product/service capabilities, and finalise sales presentations.
* Assist in the creation of Requests for Proposals (RFPs).
* Discuss commercial terms with potential clients.
* Address queries raised by prospective clients.
* Liaise internally for necessary inputs and approvals.
* Finalise contracts and close deals.
* Ensure receipt of subscription fees as per agreed terms.
* Assist Relationship Managers in the execution of their account and territory strategies.
* Support the company’s strategic and ongoing marketing and brand awareness campaigns.
* Drive prospect participation in internal and external events and webinars.
* Extend support to clients during the onboarding process.
* Respond to queries related to subscription plans and offerings.
* Log and escalate customer complaints appropriately to ensure timely resolution.
* Make regular calls to existing clients for proactive service and support.
* Resolve any issues faced by clients regarding subscription fee payments.
* Address client queries related to transaction processing by coordinating internally and following up with accurate responses.
* Guide customers on IT\-related issues on the 360tf platform or arrange expert support when required.
* Work closely with Relationship Managers to understand client requirements and deliver the best level of service to each customer segment.
* Handle queries raised by referral partners related to customer service.
* Systematically document customer interactions, turnaround times, and complaint resolutions.
* Produce regular MIS reports on customer complaints, turnaround time analysis, and resolution outcomes.

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.

title: Director - Service Delivery
description:
**Designation: Director \- Service Delivery** 




**Reporting: Associate Vice President** 




**Location: Gandhinagar, Gujarat** 




**Shift: 4:00 PM to 1:30 AM IST** 




  





**Requirements:** 



* **15\+ years of experience in Client Success, Client Delivery or Account Management.**
* **5\+ years in leadership roles managing managers and cross\-functional teams** 
 .
* **Strong experience managing US clients and executive stakeholders** 
 .
* Understanding of
 **US healthcare** 
 operations: revenue cycle management (RCM), risk adjustment, medical coding, or healthcare services preferred.
* **Proven track record of client retention, account growth, and operational excellence** 
 .
* Bachelor’s degree in business, Healthcare Administration, Management, or related field.
* Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.



  





**Position Summary:** 




 Advantmed is seeking an experienced and strategic Director \- Service Delivery to lead end\-to\-end client delivery, account growth, and client relationship management across multiple healthcare service lines. This role will oversee client\-facing teams across departments, ensuring seamless delivery, operational excellence, strong governance, and exceptional client satisfaction.
 



 The ideal candidate will have significant experience managing US\-based clients, leading cross\-functional teams, driving revenue growth, and building high\-performing client success organizations. This individual will serve as the primary bridge between clients, operations, and leadership teams to ensure long\-term client success and business growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




**1\. Client Relationship Management \& Account Growth (30%)** 



* Own and strengthen executive\-level relationships across strategic client accounts.
* Drive client satisfaction, retention, and long\-term partnership growth.
* Identify opportunities for value addition and consultative engagement across accounts.
* Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), Performance Review Meetings (PRMs/PPRs), and governance discussions.
* Partner with sales and business leaders to identify cross\-sell, upsell, and account expansion opportunities.
* Develop account growth strategies aligned with client objectives.
* Act as an escalation point for critical client issues and ensure timely resolution.



  





**2\. Operations \& Delivery Governance (30%)** 



* Maintain overall accountability for end\-to\-end client delivery across assigned portfolios.
* Ensure delivery service meets contractual obligations, SLAs, quality standards, and operational KPIs.
* Establish strong collaboration between Client Success, Operations, Quality, Technology, and Support functions.
* Monitor delivery performance and proactively address operational risks.
* Drive governance frameworks and executive reporting mechanisms.
* Lead client governance meetings and business performance discussions.
* Ensure business continuity, operational scalability, and service excellence.



  





**3\. People Leadership \& Talent Development (10%)** 



* Lead, mentor, and develop Client Success leaders including RAMs, CAMs, and PAMs.
* Build a strong leadership pipeline and succession framework.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and client\-centricity.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, and professional development initiatives.
* Support capability building, leadership coaching, and performance management.
* Promote cross\-functional teamwork and best practice sharing.



  





**4\. Strategic Initiatives \& Process Excellence (30%)** 



* Define and implement governance structures, RACI frameworks, and communication models.
* Drive organizational OKRs and strategic business initiatives.
* Identify opportunities for automation, digitization, and process optimization.
* Lead transformational initiatives that improve client experience and operational efficiency.
* Standardized reporting, dashboards, and performance management frameworks.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.
* Partner with executive leadership to execute strategic growth plans.



  





**Competencies:** 



* Executive Presence \& Stakeholder Management
* Strategic Thinking \& Business Acumen
* Client Success \& Customer Centricity
* Revenue Growth \& Account Expansion
* Operational Excellence
* Leadership \& Talent Development
* Change Management
* Program \& Portfolio Management
* Problem Solving \& Decision Making
* Negotiation \& Influencing Skills



  





**Success Metrics:** 



* Client Satisfaction (CSAT/NPS)
* Client Retention and Renewal Rates
* Revenue Growth and Account Expansion
* SLA and Quality Performance
* Governance Effectiveness
* Operational Efficiency Improvements
* Employee Engagement and Retention
* Strategic Initiative and OKR Achievement



  





**About Advantmed** 




 Founded in 2005, headquarters based in California, Advantmed is a leading Healthcare Information Management company that helps Health Plans \& MCOs (Managed Care Organizations) optimize Revenue \& improve Quality Outcomes. Advantmed partners with Health Plans \& MCO to deliver optimal combination of capabilities unique to each organization needed to achieve the objectives including Risk Analytics, Quality Analytics software certified by NCQA for HEDIS Measures, risk adjustment coding, medical record retrieval, abstraction \& coding services, including Provider Education.

title: CSM
description:
**Company Description** 
 Vidya Wires is one of India’s largest manufacturers and exporters of enameled copper wire, with over 40 years of industry experience. Based in Gujarat, the company produces a wide range of copper products, including wires, wire strips, paper\-covered strips and wires, and copper tapes. Vidya Wires focuses on building long\-term relationships by consistently delivering superior quality products and welcoming client feedback to drive continuous improvement. The company operates with strong ethical standards, earning a trusted reputation in the copper wire sector. Its strength lies in a skilled and experienced workforce committed to meeting challenges while ensuring quality and timely delivery.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time, on\-site Customer Success Manager (CSM) role based in Nadiad. The CSM will manage and nurture client relationships, ensuring that customers receive high\-quality service and support throughout their engagement with Vidya Wires. Daily responsibilities include understanding client requirements, coordinating with production and logistics teams, monitoring order status, and proactively addressing issues related to quality, delivery, and documentation. The role involves conducting regular check\-ins with clients, gathering feedback, and translating it into actionable improvements for internal teams. The CSM will also prepare reports, maintain accurate records, support onboarding of new clients, and contribute to process optimization that enhances customer satisfaction and retention.
   

**Qualifications**
* Customer relationship and account management skills, including the ability to build trust, handle client queries, and manage expectations.
* Communication and interpersonal skills for clear verbal and written interactions with clients and internal teams.
* Organizational and time\-management skills to oversee multiple accounts, follow up on deliveries, and maintain accurate documentation.
* Problem\-solving and analytical skills to understand client issues, identify root causes, and collaborate on effective solutions.
* Basic understanding of manufacturing operations and supply chain processes; experience in industrial or B2B environments is an advantage.
* Proficiency in common office software (e.g., spreadsheets, word processing, email) and ability to work with CRM or ERP tools.
* Relevant educational background in business, commerce, engineering, or a related field; equivalent experience in customer success or sales support will also be considered.
* Ability to work on\-site in Nadiad, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and maintain a client\-focused, ethical approach.
